## What and why

<!-- What does this change, and what problem does it solve? Link the issue: "Closes #123". -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Improvement to existing behaviour
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or tooling (no behaviour change)

## How it was tested

<!-- What you ran or clicked through, on what setup. Screenshots or a short recording help for UI changes. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes (gofmt, go vet, unit and integration tests)
- [ ] The dashboard builds (`npm run build` in `apps/web`)
- [ ] New or changed API routes are documented in `contracts/openapi.yaml`
- [ ] Database changes are a new migration; no applied migration was edited
- [ ] UI follows the existing components, works at phone width, and has reduced-motion alternatives for animation
- [ ] Nothing shows sample or invented data as if it were real
- [ ] User-facing text says what happened and what to do next
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if users will notice the change
